versions.content: Optionally support event displacement Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall optionally support event displacement. The following sequence of different displacement criteria shall be possible: 1. Priority; 2. Active/passive status (optional); 3. Occurrence. Rationale: Limited hardware (memory resources) in ECU. Use Case: Error memory is full and Valid event is reported to diagnostic in AUTOSAR. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
